summary: A submission filed before the provider was lost survives the loss untouched: the retry that follows cannot prove continuity, so it runs as a new Run linked to its predecessor, and the recovery Run presenting the same work replays the standing candidate instead of filing a second one. Nothing is sealed along the way, because no report was ever accepted.

loss.summary: The provider session is gone, so the retry offers neither the session it started nor a recompiled contract digest.

recovery.summary: The recovery Run presents the predecessor's work under the same Task and the same resulting tree, which is the same candidate.
